scope: Direct ordinary-native disassembly of installed-client SP configuration, activation SP qualification, payment and balance-write paths. No implementation changes, game execution, or runtime XLua override verification.

confirmedMechanisms.boundary: Ordinary SpData getter; no generic parameter-contribution list.

confirmedMechanisms.formula: If m_costMinSp >= 0 compare current SP with this minimum; otherwise canCastWithNoSp may bypass the check, else compare with SkillData.spCost.
confirmedMechanisms.comparison: Uses MathUtil.GE, not asserted here to be exact machine integer comparison.

confirmedMechanisms.formula: ReduceSp(cost) may skip for zero cost, canCastWithNoSp or the virtual canSkipReduceSp policy; otherwise it applies an SP Modifier carrying -cost.
confirmedMechanisms.boundary: A specific SP state operation, not a contribution parameter query.

confirmedMechanisms.formula: CastSkill.DoCast calls CastDirectly and then ReduceSp on success; CastSkillWithCost.DoCast instead calls ReduceSp first and proceeds to CastDirectly only on success.
confirmedMechanisms.boundary: Actual content class binding decides which path is used; the base class alone does not establish timing for derived skills.

confirmedMechanisms.formula: SetSpInternal and DoSetSpInternal use TSMath.Clamp(value, 0, maxSp) before storing the new balance.

Entity.UpdateSpData assigns the newly derived maxSp and the SP configuration/controller fields; the checked ordinary branch does not call SetSpInternal or DoSetSpInternal to clear or proportionally convert the balance.
confirmedMechanisms.boundary: This does not rule out balance operations in a caller or another override.

confirmedMechanisms.formula: The ratio path calculates ceil(current spData.spCost * Blackboard ratio), writes the selected cost and calls Entity.UpdateSpData; the explicit-value path selects an integer from Blackboard. A separate flag requests modifying minimum SP.

evidenceBoundary: SP recovery attributes have a separately verified fixed Attribute formula. These methods do not establish that capacity, activation minimum and payment share that formula.
Rune and Relic per-source rounding is recorded in the prior evidence and is a preprocessing operation; it is not a continuous pure-contribution reduction.
Static ordinary branches only. Virtual and XLua overrides may provide content-specific policies.
